newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bezeq names acting managing director.
newsitem.headline: Bezeq names acting managing director.

text.p: Bezeq Israel Telecom's board named the company's chief financial officer Avi Hochman as acting managing director until a permanent replacement is found, Bezeq said on Thursday.

Hochman, in his current office since July 1995, fills a spot left vacant since the start of the week after a civil service watchdog committee refused to let Yoram Turbowicz take the job until he had sat out a one-year cooling-off period because of a possible conflict of interest.
Turbowicz, formerly head of the Industry and Trade Ministry's anti-trust authority, had been due to take over the managing director's job from Yitzhak Kaul on March 2.

But the watchdog committe said there were potential conflicts of interest because Turbowicz had extensive dealings with Bezeq while he was anti-trust chief. On Wednesday night Turbowicz said he would not accept the Bezeq job.

Bezeq, Israel's main telecommunications carrier, has seen its monopoly over telecommIncations service gradually whittled down over the years, but it retains monopolies in basic service and infrastructure.
Bezeq said Hochman, who was an official in the Communications Ministry before joining Bezeq, would remain acting managing director until a permanent replacement is found.
